card.name: Numbers in citations and class times
card.fires_on: Punctuation and digits inside reference citations (volume and page numbers) and class schedule times such as 10:30-11:20. Also a few stray words in history prose.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: The period after a volume abbreviation, or digits of a volume number, in a journal reference.
modes.example: Estuarine, Coastal and Shelf Science, v<<.>> 22, p. Barn

modes.label: Course schedule times
modes.description: The colon or dash inside a time range in a course listing.
modes.example: MTWTh 10:30-11<<:>>20 – Th or F Quiz times

modes.label: Stray history prose
modes.description: Scattered ordinary words in narrative history text.
modes.example: hundreds of peasants<< from>> the district came to church
